prompt.text:
Create ONE NEW independently drawn animation pose of the SAME calligrapher boy in input1, identity/camera reference; input2 PRIMARY approved polished clean handpainted chibi style. References do NOT fix the standing pose. True running, full body, camera fixed, large round head440px excluding bun and short limbs,1254x1254 true transparent canvas, root centerx640 and virtualgroundy1155. Keep 70px margin on every appendage. Brown tousled straight hair with high bun, yinyang pin and plain teal hair ribbons, charcoal GOLD CLOUD short robe with ivory lining, teal jade belt, black/gold boots as reference. Anatomical RIGHT hand always grips downward-pointing black/jade/gold brush, with only ONE tassel on handle BUTT. Anatomical LEFT hand always holds BLANK hanging ivory scroll with blackgold bars and yinyang tassel. Exactly TWO small cyan ink spirits beside scroll. NO extra jewelry, effects, particles, ground shadow, letters or sprite grid. Correct real shoulder/elbow swing counter to leg lead; expose both knees/ankles/boots where anatomically visible. Genuine transparent alpha, clean edges with no red/white/green matte contamination. Facing NORTH, directly AWAY from camera, show only back of head and robe. NO eyes/nose/front belt buckle visible. Anatomical right is SCREEN RIGHT (brush), left SCREEN LEFT(scroll). FORWARD means away from viewer/up-screen; BACK means toward viewer/down-screen. Swinging trailing boots can show their soles. NEVER front-facing.
Frame 2/16. RIGHT leg bears weight and bends knee, LEFT leg begins swing with heel lifted behind. Pelvis compresses12px. RIGHT brush arm back transitioning, LEFT scroll arm forward.
